senses.gloss: to divide, distribute, esp. to dig or open a channel.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 9:2:2">Y. Snh. IX, 27ᵃ</cite> <he>פ׳ אמת המים עליו וכ׳</he> if he opened a sluice near a person, and the water came and swept him off.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:23">Tosef. Sabb. I, 23</cite> <he>פּוֹתְקִין מים לגינה וכ׳</he> you may conduct water into a garden on the eve of the Sabbath shortly before dark &c.; Bab.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Kamma 2:6">Tosef. B. Kam. II, 6</cite> <he>אילו הפותקין ביביהן וכ׳</he> those who conduct their gutters … into the public road.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 16">Gen. R. s. 16</cite>, v. <cite ref="M00215"><he>מַגְרוֹפִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Temurah 12a">Tem. 12ᵃ</cite> [read:] <he>ממלא … ופוֹתְקָן למקוה</he> he may draw a quantity of nineteen S’ah of water and let it run through a gutter into the bath.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 961:10">Yalk. Prov. 961</cite> <he>כיון שפְּתָקָהּ</he> when he cut its supply off by diverting the channel; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 16">Yalk. Gen. 16</cite> <he>שפוסקה</he>; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 10:2">Gen. R. s. 10</cite> <he>שפסקה</he>; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 51">Gen. R. s. 51</cite>, end (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 2:9">Deut. II, 9</cite>) <he>אבל אתה מְפַתֵּק הנהרות וכ׳</he> but you may divert their rivers.—Denom. <cite ref="Q00904"><he>פִּיתָּק</he></cite>, <cite ref="E00775"><he>הֶפְתֵּק</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: to be cut off, divided; esp. to be conducted, diverted.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 3:6">Tosef. Mikv. III, 6</cite> <he>ונִפְתְּקוּ ובאו לחברו</he> ed. Zuck. (oth. ed. <he>ונפסקו</he>) and the water of one pond was diverted and came into the other pond; <cite ref="Tosefta Mikvaot 3:5">ib. 5</cite> <he>ונפתקו</he> R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 3:1">Mikv. III, 1</cite> (ed. <he>ונפסקו</he>).
